questions.question: Calculate the surface area and volume of a box 20 cm × 7 cm × 30 cm.
Explain why volume is length × breadth × height, using layers of cubes.
questions.expected_answer: The base l × b gives the number of unit cubes in one layer; h gives the number of layers. For the box, 140 cubes per layer × 30 layers = 4 200 cm³.
